name: US Census Bureau Variables
description: US Census Bureau demographic variables. The variables are directly extracted from the census api. The <variable_group_name> folder is populated with variables whose codes are specified in their corresponding configuration file found at https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_time_series_extractor/tree/main/conf/variables

content.year: Int: Year of the census record. For acs5, the year is the middle year of the 5 year period.
content.<variable_name>: <Float, Int>: Value of the variable. Please look through the .yaml files at https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_time_series_extractor/tree/main/conf/variables
